description: This file contains unit tests for the AnyPopupKeyboard class in the com.anysoftkeyboard.keyboards package. It tests keyboard creation, key tagging, key mirroring, skin tone switching, and glyph visibility behaviors.

classes.name: AnyPopupKeyboardTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of the AnyPopupKeyboard class, including creation, key tagging, mirroring, skin tone switching, and glyph visibility.

methods.name: createAnyPopupKeyboard
methods.description: Helper method to create an instance of AnyPopupKeyboard with specified resource ID, skin tone, and gender.

methods.name: testKeyboardResourceConstructor
methods.description: Tests creation of keyboard from resource ID and verifies name and key count.

methods.name: testKeyboardResourceConstructorReadsTags
methods.description: Verifies that key tags are correctly read for SDK version M.

methods.name: testKeyboardResourceConstructorReadsTagsWithExtension
methods.description: Verifies that extended key tags are correctly read for SDK version N.

methods.name: assertKeyValues
methods.description: Helper method to assert key position (x, y) and primary code in the keyboard.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupCharacterStringConstructor
methods.description: Tests creation of a keyboard from a string of characters and verifies key count and positions.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupCharacterStringTwoRowsConstructor
methods.description: Verifies key positions for a two-row character string.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupCharacterStringThreeRowsConstructor
methods.description: Verifies key positions for a three-row character string.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupSupportsMirrorOneRow
methods.description: Tests mirroring of a one-row keyboard and verifies key positions are correctly mirrored.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupSupportsMirrorOneRowNotFull
methods.description: Tests mirroring of a partial one-row keyboard.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupSupportsMirrorMultipleFullRows
methods.description: Tests mirroring of a full two-row keyboard.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupSupportsMirrorMultipleRowsNotFullBalanced
methods.description: Tests mirroring of a balanced, partial two-row keyboard.

methods.name: testKeyboardPopupSupportsMirrorMultipleRowsNotFullNotBalanced
methods.description: Tests mirroring of an unbalanced, partial two-row keyboard.

methods.name: testEmptyCodes
methods.description: Verifies that keys with no codes return 0 for getCodeAtIndex.

methods.name: testKeyboardSwitchesSkinTone
methods.description: Tests that skin tone modifications are correctly applied to keys.

methods.name: testHidesKeysWithNoGlyph
methods.description: Verifies that keys without glyphs are hidden (width=0) after rendering.

methods.name: testDoesNotHideKeysWithJustText
methods.description: Verifies that keys with text are not hidden even if glyphs are missing.
